## A. 전체 아키텍처 개요

### A.1 Layered Topology (3-Tier)

```
┌─ Tier 0: Parent Orchestrator (현재 Claude Code 세션 = "the workflow runner")
│      • Single SOT writer for prompt/workflow-research/state.yaml
│      • Owns lifecycle of all teams / sub-agents / forks
│      • Routes user decisions (Step 3, 7, 15) into pastoral-decision-logs/
│      • Holds Anti-Deadlock contract: every spawn has a 30s heartbeat + fallback
│
├─ Tier 1: Phase Orchestrators (sub-agents under Tier 0)
│      • @research-orchestrator   (Step 1-2-3)
│      • @planning-orchestrator   (Step 4-5-6-7)
│      • @impl-orchestrator       (Step 7.5-15)
│      Each: reads SOT → dispatches Tier 2 → writes back via Tier 0 only.
│
└─ Tier 2: Workers
       • Agent Teams (parallel, isolated context) — Step 2, Step 5/6 cross-design
       • Specialist sub-agents (sequential) — bootstrapper / phase1-builder / etc.
       • didim-bridge wrapper — ONLY conduit to weekly-works
       • Adversarial reviewers — @reviewer + @fact-checker + @theological-reviewer
       • @translator — final EN→KO at delivery boundary only
```

**핵심 불변식**: SOT 쓰기는 *반드시* Tier 0을 통과. Tier 1·2는 자기 산출 폴더와 *제안 파일*만 쓰고, Tier 0이 SOT diff 적용. 이로써 절대 기준 2(SOT)가 코드 강제.

### A.2 Component Roles (English — per instruction)

| Component | Role | Lifetime | Writes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Parent Orchestrator** (Opus) | Single SOT writer; lifecycle owner; user-facing dialog | Whole session | `state.yaml`, `pastoral-decision-logs/`, dispatches all spawns |
| **Phase Orchestrators** (Opus) | Step routing, verification gating, retry budget enforcement | Phase-scoped | Proposal `.md` only (parent applies to SOT) |
| **Agent Teams** (4 in Step 2; 2 in Planning) | Parallel multi-domain resolution with checkpoint discipline | Step-scoped (TeamCreate→TeamDelete) | `gate-resolutions/{X}/*.md` only |
| **Specialist sub-agents** | Single-purpose builders (bootstrapper, phase1-builder, etc.) | Single-step | Their assigned output dir only |
| **Skills** | Reusable, declarative procedure (theology-reasoning, health-dashboard, spof-recovery, disaster-recovery, korean-pastoral-style, sermon-structure, biblical-hermeneutics) | Persistent | None directly — invoked by agents |
| **Hooks** | Deterministic gates fired by harness events | Persistent | exit codes + stderr; advisory writes to `runtime_directories/*-logs/` |
| **Commands** | User-invocable entry points (`/팀`, `/팀-결정`, `/팀-진입허가`, `/팀-회중허가`, `/팀-건강`, `/팀-lock-회수`, `/팀-회복`, `/팀-동시갱신-회수`, `/팀-신학시드`, `/팀-권한변경`) | Persistent | Pastoral-decision-logs entries via Tier 0 |
| **Forks (git worktrees)** | Isolation for risky / parallel / experimental flows (see A.3) | Bounded by trigger | Their worktree only; merge back through Tier 0 review |
| **Task Verification (TDD harness)** | Per-feature `_test_*.py` + validate_*.py loop | Persistent | `verification-logs/`, `pacs-logs/` |

### A.3 Where `fork` Earns Its Keep (4 use cases — judged necessary; others rejected)

1. **Step 2 four-teammate parallel context isolation** — each teammate runs in its own `git worktree` (`worktrees/gate-A/`...`gate-D/`). Why: the workflow already mandates "각 teammate는 부모 세션과 분리된 sub-agent context"; a worktree makes that durable on disk and prevents teammate-D's BL-9 draft from contaminating teammate-A's BL-5 draft when SOT is partially flushed.
2. **Step 13 self-evolution gate (D-3)** — PRD diff is *first applied in a throwaway fork*, run through validate_workflow.py + AST/section matchers, only then merged. This is the only safe interpretation of "PRD diff = 자기 진화 = Bootstrap 재진입 단일 경로 (A-5)".
3. **Step 14 disaster recovery rehearsal** — DR runbooks (SOT corruption / genome corruption / full restore) are *exercised quarterly in a fork* against synthetic damage, never against live. Outputs become regression seeds.
4. **Phase 0 Bootstrap meta-build** — the child instance at `Claude_skills/AI_churchteam/` is created in a fork first, validated by `validate_workflow.py --check-genome-inheritance`, then promoted. Prevents a half-built child polluting the user's tree.

**Rejected fork uses** (transparency): per-step backups (covered by Context Preservation Hooks), per-decision branching (covered by `pastoral-decision-logs/` + `state.yaml.entry_gates`), per-teammate model A/B testing (out of scope for v0.1).

### C.1 SOT Architecture (절대 기준 2 코드 강제)

| **Phase Orchestrators** (Opus) | Step routing, verification gating, retry budget enforcement | Phase-scoped | Proposal `.md` only (parent applies to SOT) |

### A.3 Where `fork` Earns Its Keep (4 use cases — judged necessary; others rejected)

1. **Step 2 four-teammate parallel context isolation** — each teammate runs in its own `git worktree` (`worktrees/gate-A/`...`gate-D/`). Why: the workflow already mandates "각 teammate는 부모 세션과 분리된 sub-agent context"; a worktree makes that durable on disk and prevents teammate-D's BL-9 draft from contaminating teammate-A's BL-5 draft when SOT is partially flushed.
2. **Step 13 self-evolution gate (D-3)** — PRD diff is *first applied in a throwaway fork*, run through validate_workflow.py + AST/section matchers, only then merged. This is the only safe interpretation of "PRD diff = 자기 진화 = Bootstrap 재진입 단일 경로 (A-5)".
